decisions.reason: The firm has invested in staff and accreditation for outpatient sociotherapy and promoted it to the home page in 2024, which signals growing visible commitment to a service at the core of its mental health direction.

The senior living counseling service has been featured on the home page in both years, so dropping it would contradict a publicly announced, central element of the firm's person-centered eldercare strategy.

The sheltered workshop shop moved up to the home page, the firm has sunk costs in the retail premises, and it publicly reflects the firm's participation mission, so management will attribute any weak sales to start-up effects and persist.

The meal delivery service is new and only mentioned on the website, but it fits the firm's eldercare focus, and its early results can still be explained by ramp-up, so management will give it more time rather than drop it.
